title: Who needs sleep when you have Lost Boys tickets?
transcript: Let's go rush the Lost Boys! Have heard the Lost Boys. Rush has gotten insane since the Tony's, which, you know, great for the show. Great for the show, bad for me. I have not rushed since the Tony nomination day, when I got in line at 5:30. I have heard that since then, people have gotten in line as early as the day before. Today is Wednesday, July 1st. I specifically wanna get tickets in the front row because I have not sat in the front row in a while. And today is Pierre Morais’ debut as David, which I'm very excited about. Found out a few days ago, drove from Arkansas to New York in like two days, so we have literally been driving like a crazy person. Uh, but we made it. Got like an hour of sleep and now we are headed to the theatre. Arrived at the theatre at exactly 2:00am. There were seven people already camped out and because there was two shows today, decided to join them. It is 8:30, about 90 minutes left. Grab some Dunkin. This line is only still about 20 people, so the last people in line may get tickets, just maybe not the front row. Success. Got two front row rush tickets. Only took 8 hours. home I am finally home Back at Lost Boys for round No.. 14. One of my favourite things in seeing a show over and over again is getting to see a different cast, getting to see new interpretations and getting to see cover debuts. And the energy today was absolutely electric. Not only was Pierre incredible right out of the gate, but everybody in this cast. Such a great show today. And I love when I get to see performers live in the moment and make new choices. I was laughing at jokes that I've heard 14 times now like they were completely fresh. I just. Yes, absolutely worth driving back to New York for. I will say if you wanna get rush tickets for Lost Boys, you definitely do not need to get in line at 2:00am. And you would still be able to get front row tickets. The person after me in line didn't show up until three. And again, it was still under 20 people by 8:00am. I am going to try to rush again tomorrow, showing up at 7 in the morning. There's another two show day tomorrow. It's a holiday weekend. I and I'm not as desperate to get front rows. We are gonna go at 7:00am, do a much shorter wait and see what we get. So follow along and I will take you along with me again.
